boundary: This benchmark starts the Wearedge FastAPI gateway on the final Jetson/IPC/plant edge node and measures real HTTP POST calls to /v1/workflow-canvas/decision with process resource sampling. It measures the collaborative decision path, not high-detail image/VLM inference.

resource_profile.boundary: Resource samples describe the benchmark gateway process on the node that runs this script. On Jetson, keep this profile together with tegrastats for final-round defense.

collection_context.timestamp_note: Benchmark generated_at and tegrastats timestamps come from the Jetson system clock.
